title: bbox_knowledge has no compact/titles-only mode for dedup checks; broad queries spill oversized payloads over the token cap
wanted_capability: A titles/summaries-only (or count-only) mode for bbox_knowledge so the standard "check existing memory before learning" dedup step is cheap. With limit=8 a broad query still returned full entry bodies totalling ~81KB and spilled to a file over the token cap, blocking a quick dedup scan; a tighter query was needed to get readable output. A `fields=title,summary` / `compact=true` projection would make pre-learn dedup reliable regardless of query breadth.
fallback_used: Narrowed the query with quoted phrases + a tighter limit until the result fit.
notes: Sibling pattern to gap-55be3518 (oversized escaped bro_wait/workflow envelope over the token cap) — same "MCP payload exceeds token cap, spills to file" shape on a different surface.
